title: MoatMaster
description: A paid message from MoatMaster. Home security, medieval edition.

lines.speaker: ad-ann-deep
lines.text: Worried about intruders? <p:0.2> MoatMaster digs a thirty-foot moat around your home overnight! <p:0.2> Add crocodiles for nine bucks. <p:0.2> No one gets in, including you. <p:0.2> MoatMaster, defend the castle!

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: Crocodiles do not distinguish family from foe. <p:0> Mail service permanently suspended. <p:0> Drawbridge sold as a separate ordeal. <p:0> Terms and conditions apply.
